description: Zener Diode Independent 18V 350mW Surface Mount SOD-123
designVerdict: SUPERSEDED - the resistor+Zener clamp was replaced by a follower (BSS138, now MMBT5551)
notes: BZT52C18, 18 V Zener. Was specified as the shunt half of a resistor+Zener clamping the HUSB238A VBUS pin. That topology was an INFERENCE and turned out to be wrong: Hynetek's published Figure 6 uses a BSS138 source follower with a 28 V Zener on its gate (see C7420339 and C24833806).
Not in the BOM. The part the design actually needs there is a 28 V Zener (BZT52C28 class) on the BSS138 gate - still to be selected.
